Carney Defends Liberal Mandate for Faster Project Approvals Amid Opposition

Mark Carney stated that the Liberal government has a mandate to expedite the construction of major projects. This assertion comes in response to growing pushback against the government's plans. The National Chief of the Assembly of First Nations (AFN) has cautioned Carney against "abusing" the majority to pass a new bill concerning major projects.
